children: Health-care companies fell, but not by as much as the broad market, amid merger activity.
Eli Lilly agreed to buy biotech firm Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion in cash, seeking to bulk up its immunology portfolio.
The iShares Biotech exchange-traded fund, a basket of biotechnology companies, rose in anticipation of more deals in the sub-sector.
